title: Nerif Bridge
tagline: We  built a bridge interface that allows you to send messages across different EVM chains built on top of Nerif Network
description:
"Nerif Bridge" is a proof of concept for cross-chain communication in the EVM ecosystem, enabling the transfer of messages between different EVM chains. Utilizing the Nerif Network for its underlying operations, it demonstrates a tangible approach to building scalable, cross-chain applications.

The demo is currently deployed on Ethereum Goerli, Polygon Mumbai, BSC, Gnosis Chain, and Linea, demonstrating its broad compatibility. In essence, Nerif Bridge is a practical resource for developers interested in EVM cross-chain communication.
how_its_made: Nerif Bridge is built solely with Solidity (we used Hardhat to make this a bit simpler) and is in the background supported by Nerif Workflows which coordinate the cross chain interactions. Emails are sent via AWS Lambda functions with SES and also coordinated by the Nerif Network.
